title: Shared expenses
subtitle: Trips, households and everyday costs, with people you choose.
emptyGroups: Your first shared expense starts here
emptyGroupsHelp: Create a group and add names. Invite people whenever they want to join.
soloHelp: People do not need an account. You can record expenses for everyone and invite them later.
loadFailed: Could not load shared expenses. Try again.
saveFailed: Could not save. Your changes are still here.
missingRate: A currency rate is missing. Open the marked entry to enter a rate or retry the lookup.
partialBalance: Known position: {amount}. This excludes entries with a missing rate.
emptyEntriesHelp: Add the first bill. Everyone’s share and position will be calculated for you.
equalSummary: Equally between {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
FUTURE_DATE: Planned: does not affect balances yet. Open this entry on its date to record it.
MISSING_RATE: No rate for {from} to {to} on {date}. Enter the agreed rate below or retry the lookup.
fxHelp: One {from} in {to}. This rate is kept with the expense.
previewHelp: These are the amounts that will be saved. Private accounts are connected separately.
draftSaved: Saved for later; balances have not been fully updated.
splitHelp: Choose who took part. A person can pay without having a share.
extras: Extras, then split the rest equally
extrasHelp: Enter each person’s extras first. The remaining amount is divided among selected people.
splitInvalid: Check the amounts: exact shares must add up to the total, percentages to 100, and weights must be positive.
amountChanged: The amount changed. Review the split before saving.
repaymentHelp: Record a transfer that already happened. Monize does not send money.
overpayment: I understand this payment may exceed the current suggestion.
suggestionsHelp: These transfers settle the group’s current positions. You can record a smaller payment.
refundHelp: The refund follows the original accepted split. Previous refunds are taken into account.
reverseHelp: The entry stays in the history. Balances are recalculated; private bookings wait for their owner’s review.
exportFailed: Could not export the complete group. Try again.
financeHelp: Connect your share to your accounts. Paying the whole bill records your own cost and what others owe you separately.
managedHelp: This account tracks what you are owed or owe. It is not spendable cash.
pendingCount: {count, plural, one {# entry needs review} other {# entries need review}}
bookHelp: Choose a bank entry already imported, or record a new payment. Check the preview before accepting.
sharedBankAmount: Shared part of this bank transaction
unlinkHelp: Matched bank entries remain in your ledger. Entries created by this connection are removed.
settlementChange: Change in what I am owed
financialPrivacy: Other people see the shared expense and split. They do not see your accounts, categories, payees or bank records.
fileHelp: Add tickets, bookings or photos here, even before you have an expense. Files on individual expenses appear here too.
fileFailed: The entry is saved. Some files could not be uploaded; retry the files below.
copyHelp: This creates a separate copy for the group. The private original stays private and keeps its own lifecycle.
inviteHelp: This invitation connects the person already in this group to their Monize account on this server.
inviteExpiry: Valid for 7 days. Creating another invitation replaces the previous one.
joinPrivacy: You will see this group’s expenses, people and documents. Your personal finances stay private.
invalidInvite: This invitation is invalid, expired or no longer available. Ask the group owner for a new link.
signInToJoin: Sign in using the link below, then return to this tab and refresh to accept your invitation.
accessHelp: Removing access leaves the person and their history in the group. Ownership can be transferred to a connected participant after they accept.
archiveHelp: An archived group remains readable. Reopen it before adding or editing entries.
leaveHelp: You will lose access to the group. Your recorded history and accepted private ledger entries remain.
personHelp: Keep the same person across groups and optionally link them to a payee. Groups stay separate.
noPeopleHelp: Save a person here, then link their appearances in your groups.
validation: Fill in the description, a positive amount, payer and participants.
readOnly: You can view this group. An owner or editor can add expenses.
groupCurrencyLocked: The group’s currency is fixed after the first entry or financial connection.
uploadHint: Files will be shared with the group when you choose Upload.
accessRevoked: Your access to this group has ended. These are your previously accepted private bookings. You can keep them or unlink them; the current group history is unavailable.
detachedCopyHelp: This is your independent copy from a backup. The original group and its members are separate.
unlinkConfirm: Remove this private booking and restore the original bank movement? The shared entry and other participants’ finances will stay as they are.
defaultSplitHelp: Save the people and their relative shares for future expenses. Existing entries keep their accepted split.
templateApplied: The saved default is applied. Check the names below: new participants may not be included.
templateUnavailable: The saved default includes an inactive person. This draft uses an equal split among active participants; review it before saving.
reminderHelp: This is the notification text. It opens the current group balances and respects the recipient’s notification preferences and group mute. You can remind a participant once every 24 hours.
deactivatePersonHelp: Earlier expenses and balances stay in the history. Inactive people are left out of new expenses.
weightsHelp: Relative shares: a weight of 2 gets twice the share of a weight of 1.
linkedTransactionHelp: This transaction belongs to an accepted shared booking. Open My finances to review its amounts or unlink it before editing. Documents added here stay private.
deleteContactHelp: Remove this contact and your private links? Group participants, expenses and balances will stay as they are.
deleteGroupHelp: Delete this empty group and its invitations? Groups with entries, documents or personal bookings must be archived instead.
fileLinkFailed: The expense is saved. The file is still in the group’s Files. Retry attaching it without creating another expense.
contributionPart: Part of my contribution covered by this payment
paymentsHelp: Divide your contribution between these payments in the original expense currency. The parts must add up to your contribution. Your personal cost is booked once.
includeOwnFinances: Also record this in my finances
combinedBookingHelp: Review your own bank payments and category next. The expense and your personal booking will be saved together.
ownContextOnly: Shared expenses belong to your own profile. Switch back to your profile to view your groups.
bankStartHelp: Choose a group, then create an expense or match one already recorded.
bankPrivacyHelp: Your account, category and private attachments are visible only to you. Review the expense before sharing it with the group.
bankNotEligible: Choose an unreconciled payment from your own open bank or cash account. Category-only splits are supported; transfers and investment entries are not.
matchHelp: Choose the recorded expense to connect this payment without creating another expense. Amounts and dates are suggestions, never an automatic match.
ownershipAccepted: {name} accepted. The current owner can complete the handover.
ownershipResponsibility: The new owner will manage access and group settings. The previous owner will remain an editor. Private bank accounts and personal bookings stay with their owners.
pendingFilesLeave: Some selected files have not been uploaded. Stay here to upload them, or leave and discard the selection.
summaryUnknown: A group has an unresolved exchange rate. Open its highlighted expense to complete the balance.
sourceSplitPortions: Choose portions from the original split
sourceSplitHelp: Enter only the amount to share from each line. The remainder keeps its original categories, notes and tags.
reviewLedgerBasis: Your accounts, budgets and reports use the shared bookings you have accepted. Changes made in a group reach your personal finances only after you review them. Reports restricted to bank accounts exclude costs booked in settlement accounts.
reviewPending: Shared expenses awaiting your review: {count}. Reports include your accepted bookings.
reviewUnavailable: Linked groups with access ended: {count}. Their latest changes cannot be checked; accepted bookings remain in your reports.
reviewLoadFailed: Shared-expense changes could not be checked. Reports still use your accepted bookings. Retry to check for pending changes.
reviewCurrent: All available shared changes have been reviewed.
reviewEmpty: No groups included in your finances yet.
multipleReceivers: More than one person received this
contributionsMismatch: The amounts paid or received must add up to the amount above.
selectPeople: Choose at least one person for this split.
repaymentExplanation: Suggestions use everyone’s net balance. You may repay someone who did not pay for your particular expense.
